build_openpangu_vl_model: build an OpenPanguVLForConditionalGeneration multimodal model with VllmConfig for image and video understanding
create_vision_transformer: create an OpenPanguVisionTransformer that processes images and videos with rotary embeddings and windowed attention
run_image_embedding: run image pixel values through the visual encoder to produce image embeddings with grid-thw positional info
run_video_embedding: run video pixel values through the visual encoder to produce video embeddings with temporal grid-thw info
test_multimodal_processor: test OpenPanguVLMultiModalProcessor to replace image and video tokens in prompts with correct token IDs
